title: Hawaii community-based economic development technical and financial assistance program.
bodyText: There is established the Hawaii community-based economic development technical and financial assistance program, placed within the department.
bodyHtml: §210D-3  Hawaii community-based economic development technical and financial assistance program.  There is established the Hawaii community-based economic development technical and financial assistance program, placed within the department. [L 1990, c 111, pt of §2; am L 1996, c 192, §4]
